references.text: Parallel account of how Sihon refused to let Israel pass through his land and gathered his army to fight against them.
Jephthah refers to this event where Sihon did not trust Israel and gathered his people to fight against them at Jahaz.
The immediate context in which Israel sent messengers to Sihon with a peaceful request to pass through his land.
Continuation of the account where Israel defeats Sihon and takes possession of his land and cities.
Moses reminds the people how Sihon, king of Heshbon, came out to fight against them but was defeated.
The psalmist praises the Lord for the victory over Sihon, king of the Amorites.
A praise that mentions God's victory over Sihon, king of the Amorites, as part of God's great deeds.
